subject: Fix inconsistencies in the json command file descriptions (#63)
reason: The change only edits the natural-language 'description' strings inside reply_schema blocks of src/commands/*.json (capitalization and trailing periods). These strings are compiled into the server only under -DLOG_REQ_RES (src/Makefile gates --with-reply-schema on it), which the standard builds under test don't use; even in such a build they appear only as doc text in COMMAND DOCS. No command behavior, reply, argument parsing, or persisted state changes, so no scenario can observe a difference.
